meta.title: dsh-connect-workbuddy
meta.description: Connects locally signed-in WorkBuddy models, CN and international alike, to DSH, reading each model's credit multiplier from the upstream catalog on every refresh, with per-model image input toggles, a per-model default reasoning level, account switching backed by an auto-failing-over pool, manual daily check-in, and read-only credit overviews shown as compact pills on the card and in the composer.
